  }

  function track() {
    if (!window.posthog) return;

    // Global nav clicks (old and new nav)
    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      if (optedOut()) return;
      var navEl = e.target.closest('a, button');
      if (!navEl || !navEl.closest(NAV_SEL)) return;
      var label = resolveLabel(navEl);
      var level = navLevel(navEl);
      var props = {
        nav_text: label.text,
        nav_label_source: label.source,
        nav_href: navEl.getAttribute('href') || null,
        nav_classes: cls(navEl).slice(0, 120),
        nav_is_dropdown_trigger: isTrigger(navEl),
        nav_is_logo: level === 'logo',
        nav_level: level,
        nav_menu: navMenu(navEl),
        nav_position: navPosition(navEl, level),
        nav_viewport: isMobileNav() ? 'mobile' : 'desktop',
        nav_version: inNewNav(navEl) ? 'v1.4' : 'pre-v1.4',
        tracking_version: TV,
        page_path: window.location.pathname
      };
      if (level === 'menu_toggle') {
        var closing = navEl.classList.contains('active') || navEl.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true' || /close/i.test(navEl.getAttribute('aria-label') || '');
        props.nav_action = closing ? 'close' : 'open';
        props.nav_text = 'Menu';
      }
      window.posthog.capture('nav_click', props);
    }, true);

    // Hero clicks (old stacked hero and new Osano tour hero)
    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      if (optedOut()) return;
      var heroEl = e.target.closest('a, button');
      if (!heroEl) return;
      var hero = heroEl.closest(HERO_SEL);
      if (!hero || heroEl.closest(NAV_SEL)) return;
      var isNew = hero.classList.contains('osano-hero-section');
      window.posthog.capture('hero_click', {
        hero_text: (heroEl.textContent || heroEl.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').trim().slice(0, 100),
        hero_href: heroEl.getAttribute('href') || null,
        hero_is_cta: heroEl.classList.contains('cta-link') || (isNew && !!heroEl.closest('.osano-hero-actions')),
        hero_element: isNew && heroEl.closest('.oht, .otv') ? 'tour_control' : 'link',
        hero_version: isNew ? heroVer(hero) : 'stacked',
        hero_tour_chapter: isNew ? tourChapter(hero) : null,
        tracking_version: TV,
        page_path: window.location.pathname
      });
    }, true);

    // Content CTA and link clicks (outside nav, hero, footer and HubSpot tools)
    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      if (optedOut()) return;
      var el = e.target.closest('a, button');
      if (!el) return;
      if (el.closest(NAV_SEL + ', footer, .hs-tools-menu, #hs-web-interactives-top-anchor, .hs-sprocket-button, #hubspot-messages-iframe-container, [class*="osano-cm-"]')) return;
      if (el.closest(HERO_SEL)) return;
      if (el.closest('form') && (el.type === 'submit' || el.tagName === 'BUTTON')) return;
      var c = cls(el);
      var label = resolveLabel(el);
      window.posthog.capture('cta_click', {
        cta_text: label.text,
        cta_label_source: label.source,
        cta_href: el.getAttribute('href') || null,
        cta_kind: ctaKind(el, c),
        cta_classes: c.slice(0, 120),
        cta_id: el.getAttribute('data-cta-id') || null,
        cta_section: sectionOf(el),
        tracking_version: TV,
        page_path: window.location.pathname
      });
    }, true);

    // Footer link clicks (v2.4)
    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      if (optedOut()) return;
      var el = e.target.closest('a, button');
      if (!el) return;
      var foot = el.closest('footer');
      if (!foot || el.closest('form')) return;
      var col = 'other';
      var grid = el.closest('.footer-links-grid-container');
      if (grid) {
        var h = grid.previousElementSibling;
        col = h && /H\d/.test(h.tagName) ? squash(h.textContent) : 'links';
      } else if (el.closest('.footer-social-links-container, .footer-social-links-wrapper')) {
        col = 'social';
      } else if (el.closest('.footer-logo-container') || /logo/i.test(cls(el))) {
        col = 'logo';
      } else if (el.closest('.hs-richtext, [class*="copyright"], [class*="bottom"]')) {
        col = 'policy text';
      }
      var links = Array.prototype.slice.call(foot.querySelectorAll('a'));
      var label = resolveLabel(el);
      window.posthog.capture('footer_click', {
        footer_text: label.text,
        footer_label_source: label.source,
        footer_href: el.getAttribute('href') || null,
        footer_column: col.slice(0, 40),
        footer_position: links.indexOf(el) + 1 || null,
        tracking_version: TV,
        page_path: window.location.pathname
      });
    }, true);

    // Hero scroll depth (whichever hero the page has)
    var heroSection = document.querySelector(HERO_SEL);
    if (!heroSection) return;
    var heroVersion = heroVer(heroSection);
    var thresholds = [25, 50, 75, 100];
    var fired = {};
    var ticking = false;
    function checkScrollDepth() {
      ticking = false;
      if (optedOut()) return;
      var rect = heroSection.getBoundingClientRect();
      var heroHeight = rect.height || 1;
      var viewportHeight = window.innerHeight || document.documentElement.clientHeight;
      var scrolledPast = viewportHeight - rect.top;
      var pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round((scrolledPast / heroHeight) * 100)));
      thresholds.forEach(function (t) {
        if (pct >= t && !fired[t]) {
          fired[t] = true;
          window.posthog.capture('hero_scroll_depth', {
            depth_percent: t,
            hero_version: heroVersion,
            tracking_version: TV,
            page_path: window.location.pathname
          });
        }
      });
    }
    window.addEventListener('scroll', function () {
      if (!ticking) { ticking = true; window.requestAnimationFrame(checkScrollDepth); }
    }, { passive: true });
    checkScrollDepth();

    // Hero tour v2 chapter views (v2.5): one event per chapter per page view, counted only while the tour is on screen.
    var tour = heroSection.querySelector('.otv');
    if (tour) {
      var seen = {}, lastInput = { type: null, at: 0 }, onScreen = false, t0 = Date.now();
      tour.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (e.target.closest('.otv-seg')) lastInput = { type: 'click', at: Date.now() }; }, true);
      tour.addEventListener('touchend', function () { lastInput = { type: 'swipe', at: Date.now() }; }, { passive: true });
      var sendView = function () {
        if (!onScreen || optedOut() || !window.posthog) return;
        var seg = tour.querySelector('.otv-seg[aria-selected="true"]');
        if (!seg) return;
        var name = seg.getAttribute('data-tour-tab');
        if (!name || seen[name]) return;
        seen[name] = true;
        var segs = tour.querySelectorAll('.otv-seg');
        var nSeen = Object.keys(seen).length;
        var recent = Date.now() - lastInput.at < 800;
        window.posthog.capture('hero_tour_view', {
          chapter_name: name,
          chapter_index: Array.prototype.indexOf.call(segs, seg) + 1,
          chapters_total: segs.length,
          chapters_seen: nSeen,
          trigger: recent ? lastInput.type : (nSeen === 1 ? 'initial' : 'auto'),
          seconds_on_page: Math.round((Date.now() - t0) / 1000),
          hero_version: heroVer(heroSection),
          tracking_version: TV,
          page_path: window.location.pathname
        });
      };
      if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
        new IntersectionObserver(function (en) { onScreen = en[0].isIntersecting; if (onScreen) sendView(); }, { threshold: 0.5 }).observe(tour);
      } else { onScreen = true; }
      var segsBox = tour.querySelector('.otv-segs');
      if (segsBox && 'MutationObserver' in window) {
        new MutationObserver(function () { sendView(); }).observe(segsBox, { attributes: true, subtree: true, attributeFilter: ['aria-selected'] });
      }
    }
  }

  // Named form submission event (form ID and page only; no field values are sent). Unchanged.
  window.addEventListener('message', function (event) {
    if (event.origin !== window.location.origin && !/^https:\/\/([a-z0-9-]+\.)*(hsforms\.(com|net)|hubspot\.com)$/.test(event.origin)) return;
    var d = event.data;
    if (!d || d.type !== 'hsFormCallback' || d.eventName !== 'onFormSubmitted') return;
    if (!window.posthog || optedOut()) return;
    window.posthog.capture('form_submitted', {
      form_id: d.id || null,
      tracking_version: TV,
      page_path: window.location.pathname,
      page_title: (document.title || '').slice(0, 120)
    });
  });

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', track);
  } else {
    track();
  }
})();
</script>

<!-- PostHog Video Tracking (v1.0, Oct 27 2026): HubSpot video, Vimeo, YouTube. Docs in Notion. -->
<script>
/**
 * PostHog Video Tracking (v1.0, Oct 27 2026)
 * Tracks every video on osano.com: HubSpot-hosted videos, Vimeo and YouTube embeds.
 * Events (all share the same properties):
 *   video_started   - first play of a video in this pageview
 *   video_progress  - each milestone reached once per pageview (video_milestone = 10, 25, 50, 75, 90)
 *   video_completed - reached 95% or the player reported "ended"
 *   video_summary   - one per watched video when the visitor leaves the page:
 *                     seconds watched, furthest point reached, plays, pauses, seeks
 * Core properties: video_platform, video_id, video_title, video_duration_s, video_page_type,
 *   video_section_heading, video_index_on_page, video_count_on_page, video_seconds_into_page
 * Docs: Notion "Video Tracking (PostHog)" page.
 */
(function () {
  if (window.__osanoVideoTracking) return;
  window.__osanoVideoTracking = true;

  var MILESTONES = [10, 25, 50, 75, 90];
  var COMPLETE_AT = 95;
  var pageLoadedAt = Date.now();
  var videos = []; // tracked video state objects
  var queue = [];

  // ---------- helpers ----------
  function ph() { return window.posthog && typeof window.posthog.capture === 'function' ? window.posthog : null; }
  function capture(name, props, opts) {
    var p = ph();
    if (p) { try { p.capture(name, props, opts); } catch (e) {} }
    else queue.push([name, props, opts]);
  }
  var flushTimer = setInterval(function () {
    var p = ph();
    if (!p) return;
    while (queue.length) { var q = queue.shift(); try { p.capture(q[0], q[1], q[2]); } catch (e) {} }
    clearInterval(flushTimer);
  }, 1000);
  setTimeout(function () { clearInterval(flushTimer); }, 60000);

  function pageType() {
    var p = location.pathname.replace(/\/$/, '');
    if (/^\/request\/demo/.test(p)) return 'demo';
    if (/^\/request\/meeting/.test(p)) return 'meeting_confirmation';
    if (/^\/solutions\//.test(p)) return 'solution';
    if (/^\/products?\//.test(p)) return 'product';
    if (/^\/partners?\//.test(p) || /partners-resellers/.test(p)) return 'partner';
    if (/^\/webinar\/(ty-|thank-you)/.test(p) || /thank-you/.test(p)) return 'webinar_recording';
    if (/webinar/.test(p) || /^\/l\/webinar/.test(p)) return 'webinar';
    if (p === '') return 'home';
    return 'other';
  }

  function sectionHeading(el) {
    var node = el;
    for (var i = 0; i < 8 && node; i++) {
      node = node.parentElement;
      if (!node) break;
      var h = node.querySelector('h1, h2, h3');
      if (h && h.innerText && h.innerText.trim()) return h.innerText.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 120);
    }
    return null;
  }

  function allVideoFrames() {
    return Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('iframe')).filter(function (f) {
      return /play\.hubspotvideo\.com|player\.vimeo\.com|youtube(-nocookie)?\.com\/embed/.test(f.src || '')
        || !!(f.closest && f.closest('.hs-video-widget'));
    });
  }

  function baseProps(v) {
    var frames = allVideoFrames();
    return {
      video_platform: v.platform,
      video_id: v.id != null ? String(v.id) : null,
      video_title: v.title || null,
      video_duration_s: v.duration ? Math.round(v.duration) : null,
      video_page_type: pageType(),
      video_section_heading: v.heading,
      video_index_on_page: v.iframe ? frames.indexOf(v.iframe) + 1 || null : null,
      video_count_on_page: frames.length,
      video_seconds_into_page: Math.round((Date.now() - pageLoadedAt) / 1000)
    };
  }

  function makeState(platform, iframe) {
    var v = {
      platform: platform, iframe: iframe, id: null, title: null, duration: null,
      heading: iframe ? sectionHeading(iframe) : null,
      started: false, completed: false, hit: {}, playing: false,
      lastTime: null, secondsWatched: 0, maxTime: 0, plays: 0, pauses: 0, seeks: 0, summarySent: false
    };
    videos.push(v);
    return v;
  }

  function pct(v, t) { return v.duration ? Math.min(100, (t / v.duration) * 100) : null; }

  // ---------- shared event logic ----------
  function onPlay(v) {
    v.playing = true;
    v.plays += 1;
    if (!v.started) {
      v.started = true;
      capture('video_started', baseProps(v));
    }
  }
  function onPause(v) {
    if (v.playing) v.pauses += 1;
    v.playing = false;
  }
  function onTime(v, t) {
    if (typeof t !== 'number' || isNaN(t)) return;
    if (v.lastTime != null) {
      var d = t - v.lastTime;
      if (d > 0 && d <= 3) v.secondsWatched += d;
      else if (Math.abs(d) > 3) v.seeks += 1;
    }
    v.lastTime = t;
    if (t > v.maxTime) v.maxTime = t;
    var p = pct(v, t);
    if (p == null || !v.started) return;
    MILESTONES.forEach(function (m) {
      if (p >= m && !v.hit[m]) {
        v.hit[m] = true;
        var props = baseProps(v);
        props.video_milestone = m;
        props.video_seconds_watched = Math.round(v.secondsWatched);
        capture('video_progress', props);
      }
    });
    if (p >= COMPLETE_AT) onEnded(v);
  }
  function onEnded(v) {
    v.playing = false;
    if (v.completed || !v.started) return;
    v.completed = true;
    var props = baseProps(v);
    props.video_seconds_watched = Math.round(v.secondsWatched);
    capture('video_completed', props);
  }
  function sendSummaries() {
    videos.forEach(function (v) {
      if (!v.started || v.summarySent) return;
      v.summarySent = true;
      var props = baseProps(v);
      props.video_seconds_watched = Math.round(v.secondsWatched);
      props.video_max_seconds = Math.round(v.maxTime);
      props.video_max_percent = v.duration ? Math.round(pct(v, v.maxTime)) : null;
      props.video_percent_watched = v.duration ? Math.round(Math.min(100, (v.secondsWatched / v.duration) * 100)) : null;
      props.video_completed = v.completed;
      props.video_play_count = v.plays;
      props.video_pause_count = v.pauses;
      props.video_seek_count = v.seeks;
      capture('video_summary', props, { transport: 'sendBeacon' });
    });
  }
  window.__osanoVideoSummaries = sendSummaries;
  window.addEventListener('pagehide', sendSummaries);
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () {
    if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') sendSummaries();
  });

  // ---------- HubSpot video (postMessage from play.hubspotvideo.com) ----------
  var hsByEmbed = {};
  function hsFrameFor(source) {
    var frames = document.querySelectorAll('iframe');
    for (var i = 0; i < frames.length; i++) { if (frames[i].contentWindow === source) return frames[i]; }
    return null;
  }
  window.addEventListener('message', function (e) {
    if (e.origin !== 'https://play.hubspotvideo.com') return;
    var d = e.data;
    if (typeof d === 'string') { try { d = JSON.parse(d); } catch (x) { return; } }
    if (!d || !d.type || !d.embedId) return;
    var v = hsByEmbed[d.embedId];
    if (!v) { v = hsByEmbed[d.embedId] = makeState('hubspot', hsFrameFor(e.source)); }
    if (d.videoId && !v.id) v.id = d.videoId;
    if (d.videoTitle && !v.title) v.title = d.videoTitle;
    var p = d.payload || {};
    switch (d.type) {
      case 'VIDEO_LOADED':
        if (p.duration) v.duration = p.duration > 10000 ? p.duration / 1000 : p.duration;
        if (p.title && !v.title) v.title = p.title;
        break;
      case 'PLAYER_PLAY': onPlay(v); break;
      case 'PLAYER_PAUSE': onPause(v); break;
      case 'PLAYER_TIME_UPDATE':
      case 'PLAYER_PROGRESS': onTime(v, p.currentTime); break;
      case 'PLAYER_ENDED':
      case 'PLAYER_COMPLETE':
      case 'PLAYER_COMPLETED': onEnded(v); break;
    }
  });

  // ---------- Vimeo and YouTube ----------
  // Uses each player's own postMessage interface (no extra third-party scripts, so nothing
  // for the consent manager to block; we only talk to embeds that are already on the page).
  var byWindow = []; // [{win, v, kind}]
  function stateForSource(src) {
    for (var i = 0; i < byWindow.length; i++) { if (byWindow[i].win === src) return byWindow[i]; }
    return null;
  }
  function post(iframe, msg, origin) {
    try { iframe.contentWindow.postMessage(typeof msg === 'string' ? msg : JSON.stringify(msg), origin); } catch (e) {}
  }

  function vimeoOrigin() { return 'https://player.vimeo.com'; }
  function vimeoHello(iframe) {
    ['play', 'pause', 'ended', 'timeupdate'].forEach(function (ev) {
      post(iframe, { method: 'addEventListener', value: ev }, vimeoOrigin());
    });
    post(iframe, { method: 'getVideoTitle' }, vimeoOrigin());
    post(iframe, { method: 'getDuration' }, vimeoOrigin());
  }
  function trackVimeo(iframe) {
    if (iframe.__osanoVid) return;
    iframe.__osanoVid = true;
    var v = makeState('vimeo', iframe);
    var m = (iframe.src || '').match(/video\/(\d+)/);
    v.id = m ? m[1] : null;
    var entry = { win: iframe.contentWindow, v: v, kind: 'vimeo', iframe: iframe, heard: false };
    byWindow.push(entry);
    var tries = 0;
    var t = setInterval(function () {
      entry.win = iframe.contentWindow;
      if (entry.heard || ++tries > 20) return clearInterval(t);
      vimeoHello(iframe);
    }, 750);
    vimeoHello(iframe);
    iframe.addEventListener('load', function () { entry.win = iframe.contentWindow; vimeoHello(iframe); });
  }

  function ytOrigin(iframe) { try { return new URL(iframe.src).origin; } catch (e) { return '*'; } }
  function ytHello(iframe, id) {
    post(iframe, { event: 'listening', id: id, channel: 'widget' }, ytOrigin(iframe));
    post(iframe, { event: 'command', func: 'addEventListener', args: ['onStateChange'], id: id, channel: 'widget' }, ytOrigin(iframe));
  }
  var ytSeq = 0;
  function trackYouTube(iframe) {
    if (iframe.__osanoVid) return;
    iframe.__osanoVid = true;
    var v = makeState('youtube', iframe);
    var m = (iframe.src || '').match(/embed\/([\w-]{11})/);
    v.id = m ? m[1] : null;
    var id = 'osano-yt-' + (++ytSeq);
    var entry = { win: null, v: v, kind: 'youtube', iframe: iframe, heard: false, state: -1 };
    byWindow.push(entry);
    function start() {
      entry.win = iframe.contentWindow;
      var tries = 0;
      var t = setInterval(function () {
        if (entry.heard || ++tries > 20) return clearInterval(t);
        ytHello(iframe, id);
      }, 750);
      ytHello(iframe, id);
    }
    try {
      var u = new URL(iframe.src);
      if (u.searchParams.get('enablejsapi') !== '1') {
        u.searchParams.set('enablejsapi', '1');
        u.searchParams.set('origin', location.origin);
        iframe.addEventListener('load', start, { once: true });
        iframe.src = u.toString();
        return;
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    start();
  }

  window.addEventListener('message', function (e) {
    if (!/^https:\/\/(player\.vimeo\.com|www\.youtube(-nocookie)?\.com)$/.test(e.origin)) return;
    var entry = stateForSource(e.source);
    if (!entry) return;
    var d = e.data;
    if (typeof d === 'string') { try { d = JSON.parse(d); } catch (x) { return; } }
    if (!d) return;
    entry.heard = true;
    var v = entry.v;
    if (entry.kind === 'vimeo') {
      if (d.method === 'getVideoTitle' && d.value) v.title = d.value;
      if (d.method === 'getDuration' && d.value) v.duration = d.value;
      var data = d.data || {};
      if (data.duration) v.duration = data.duration;
      if (d.event === 'ready') vimeoHello(entry.iframe);
      else if (d.event === 'play') onPlay(v);
      else if (d.event === 'pause') onPause(v);
      else if (d.event === 'timeupdate' || d.event === 'playProgress') onTime(v, data.seconds);
      else if (d.event === 'ended' || d.event === 'finish') onEnded(v);
    } else {
      var info = d.info;
      if (d.event === 'onStateChange' && typeof info === 'number') info = { playerState: info };
      if (!info || typeof info !== 'object') return;
      if (info.duration) v.duration = info.duration;
      if (info.videoData && info.videoData.title) v.title = info.videoData.title;
      if (typeof info.currentTime === 'number' && entry.state === 1) onTime(v, info.currentTime);
      if (typeof info.playerState === 'number' && info.playerState !== entry.state) {
        var prev = entry.state;
        entry.state = info.playerState;
        if (info.playerState === 1) { if (prev === 3 && v.started && v.playing) { } else onPlay(v); }
        else if (info.playerState === 2) onPause(v);
        else if (info.playerState === 0) onEnded(v);
      }
    }
  });

  // ---------- discovery (initial + late-loaded embeds, e.g. after consent) ----------
  function scan() {
    var frames = document.querySelectorAll('iframe');
    for (var i = 0; i < frames.length; i++) {
      var src = frames[i].src || '';
      if (/player\.vimeo\.com\/video\//.test(src)) trackVimeo(frames[i]);
      else if (/youtube(-nocookie)?\.com\/embed\//.test(src)) trackYouTube(frames[i]);
    }
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', scan); else scan();
  window.addEventListener('load', scan);
  try {
    var pending = false;
    new MutationObserver(function () {
      if (pending) return;
      pending = true;
      setTimeout(function () { pending = false; scan(); }, 500);
    }).observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['src'] });
  } catch (e) {}
})();
</script>
<script>
/**
 * PostHog Tool Tracking (v1.0, Oct 28 2026)
 * Adds in-tool events, per the osano.com Tools and Calculators Standard, to three tools that had none:
 * - Enforcement Tracker (/tools/data-privacy-fines-and-penalties-tracker), prefix et_
